name: Cloud Gate (The Bean)
desc: Chicago's giant chrome bean. Free funhouse mirror, mandatory selfie, your reflection warped into modern art.

name: Art Institute of Chicago
desc: Lions out front, Seurat's dots inside. One ticket, several centuries. Ferris Bueller stared here; so will you.

name: Willis Tower Skydeck
desc: Step onto a glass ledge 103 floors up and reconsider your choices. Four states visible on a clear day.

name: Navy Pier
desc: Free to stroll, ferris wheel extra. Lake breeze, summer fireworks, tourist chaos that somehow charms.

name: Lincoln Park Zoo
desc: One of America's last free zoos. Lions for the price of nothing. The ultimate broke-day royalty move.

name: Chicago Riverwalk
desc: Walk between skyscrapers at water level while architecture boats narrate overhead. Your feet are the free tour.

name: Field Museum
desc: Home of Sue, the internet's sassiest T. rex. Acres of dead things that feel extremely alive.

name: Wrigley Field
desc: Century-old ivy walls. Bleacher seats on a losing streak cost less than a deep dish — that's the move.

name: Garfield Park Conservatory
desc: Landscape art under glass — a free indoor jungle for when the lake wind gets personal in January.
